description: Huawei Cloud full-resource query and resource marker table generation toolchain. Driven by KooCLI (hcloud), covering 40+ cloud services and 80+ resource types (compute/storage/network/database/security/CDN etc.), with full-region auto-discovery concurrent query, format conversion, and one-click marker table generation. Scenarios: cloud resource inventory, resource architecture topology data collection, resource marker table generation, cross-account resource reconciliation. Trigger words: 资源查询, 全量查询, 资源盘点, resource query, resource archive, 资源标记表, marker table, KooCLI, hcloud, 资源归档
